Divali men banaye chakli ghar pe bane aate se - Chakli Recipe - Chakli Bhajni Mix Recipe
Dipavli ke is khas avsar par banaiye ekdam krispi, kurkuri aur svadisht chakli, vo bhi ghar par hi taiyar kiye gae khas chakli bhajni aate se! is vidiyo men dekhen chakli ka primiks banane se lekar ekdam sahi aur khasta chakli talne ki puri aasan vidhi.
Agar aapki chakli aksar tel men tut jati hai ya naram par jati hai, to is aasan resipi aur khas tips se aapki chakli har bar parphekt banegi.
